' > factory/specs/011-f.md; source "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/tracker.sh"; tracker_shelve factory/specs/011-f.md me 'deprioritized' >/dev/null; R="$(tracker_report)"; row() { printf '%s' "$R" | awk -F'\t' -v i="$1" '$2==i {print $4"|"$5}'; }; jq -n --arg r1 "$(row 001)" --arg r2 "$(row 002)" --arg r3 "$(row 003)" --arg r4 "$(row 004)" '{r1: $r1, r2: $r2, r3: $r3, r4: $r4}'
_note: the whole point of the column. A dep that is merely `building` clears on its own; a shelved one never does, and before this split the two were indistinguishable in the report. Row 004 is the discriminating case: it must list BOTH ids as waiting but only the shelved one as stalled, so a naive 'copy waits into stalled' implementation fails here.
